checks.name: process kill and clarification checkpoint recovery
checks.evidence: After SIGKILL and restart, the same task_id b4bdfa4a-5426-4775-894b-6810fbb5a0d7 resumed and advanced to version 2 / LangGraph step 5

checks.name: process restart full completion
checks.evidence: The resumed 3-lead request produced no response within 30 seconds and remained RUNNING; the earlier attempt exceeded two minutes. Latest checkpoint stopped at LangGraph step 5 after Phase 3 planning. Redis socket timeout hardening did not resolve this business-flow stall.

checks.name: graceful SIGTERM with in-flight request
checks.evidence: Uvicorn remained at 'Waiting for background tasks to complete' beyond the configured 30-second grace period and required SIGKILL

checks.name: PostgreSQL backup and restore mechanics
checks.evidence: Custom-format pg_dump restored cleanly into a separate database at Alembic 0008; lead_tasks=3, lead_task_versions=4 and checkpoints=59 matched the source

checks.name: full business artifact restore
checks.evidence: Source and restored database both had enterprise_evidence=0, lead_scores=0 and exports=0 after completed Golden flows because the production graph still uses in-memory Phase 2-7 repositories (FA-001)

checks.name: external provider smoke
checks.evidence: Commercial provider credentials were not available; no external operation was claimed

release_impact: Mandatory restart/resume, graceful shutdown and full backup/restore gates are not satisfied; release decision cannot be GO.
